traditional: 將 A 整到同 B 一樣
jyutping: zoeng1 A zing2 dou3 tung4 B jat1 joeng6

english.note: Use this construction when describing making one thing match another in level, amount, or quality.

examples.english: I’ll make the volume equal to yours.
examples.traditional: 我將個音量整到同你一樣。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 go3 jam1 loeng6 zing2 dou3 tung4 nei5 jat1 joeng6
